# Texuli MCP page (texuli.com)

**App:** `apps/website`
**Path:** `/mcp-server/` (Agents group, after Developers). Not `/mcp`:
`functions/mcp.ts` owns that path (the remote server itself).
**Data:** `src/components/mcp-server/mcp-server-data.ts` (generated by
`scripts/generate-surfaces.ts` from the operations registry; `pnpm
check:surfaces` fails on drift) through `src/components/mcp-server/page.ts`
**Tests:** `apps/website/tests/site-mcp-tokens.test.ts`,
`tests/e2e/site-mcp.spec.ts`

## Goal

One page for the whole MCP server (PLAN_011 T-site-090): what it is, the two
doors (remote `https://texuli.com/mcp`, local `npx -y @texuli/mcp`, or `texuli mcp` from an
installed `@texuli/tools`), setup for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code,
Windsurf, Codex and any other host, the tools by runtime (edge, node, site)
with their doors and limits, resources and templates, prompts, limits and
security (links to SECURITY sections 6, 21, 21a and 23), versions and the
renamed tools, the site tools and the WebMCP bridge, and a curl example. The
[developer portal](site-api.md) keeps its short MCP section and links here.

## Generated versus written

| Part | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Tools, resources, templates, prompts, deprecated names, versions, protocol versions | `mcp-server-data.ts` (generated) |
| Remote limits | `src/lib/mcp-limits.ts` (the numbers the endpoint enforces) |
| WebMCP tools | `webMcpTools()` from `src/lib/webmcp.ts`, read at build time |
| Release status | `API_RELEASE_STATUS` in `src/lib/api-surface.ts` |
| Host snippets | Built in `page.ts` from the launch command and the remote URL; the unit test checks the local ones against `packages/mcp/README.md` |
| Prose (what it is, the doors, security summary) | Written in the page |

## Constraints

Static: no island and no script of its own. Styles are page-wide under one
wrapper class (`.tx-mcp-ref`), so Astro writes no scope attribute on each
table cell. HTML 21.2 KB gzip (inside the default); the page weight has an
override in `src/components/perf/budgets.ts` (measured 100.3 KB, limit 105).
